answer: Histories are stored in onyx, checked in comet, and karst publishes each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 12 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 4115 identities would post 3394 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
